about: v0.6 Kathā story lines (OWNER: v0.6 WP-D): the new English lines inside { "if": "style.katha", "then": [...] } blocks of cutscene-herbs.json that no file 1–9 held at v0.5.1, and new Kathā-only speaker titles ("label": true). Rule: sa-verify collectStoryStrings; notes/v06-ownership.md. Same format and rules as files 1–9 (notes/sambhashana.md). Sources of each line: notes/v06-d.md.

models.source: MW himavat m. 'the Himālaya' (via kosha.sanskrit.today, read 2026-11-14); Yuddha 6.74.29 (vulgate, valmikiramayan.net): हिमवन्तं नगश्रेष्ठं हनूमन्गन्तुमर्हसि; vat-stem declined like भगवत् (हिमवान्, हिमवन्तम्)

entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · title (label, Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.31 सर्वौषधियुतं … औषधिपर्वतम्

entries.en: Hanuman leaps into the sky, towards the Himalaya.
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.29 (Jāmbavān: हिमवन्तं … गन्तुमर्हसि), 6.74.49 (he leaps into the sky), 6.74.53–56 (he flies to the Himālaya)

entries.en: Between Rishabha and Kailasa, the mountain of herbs shines.
entries.sa: ऋषभस्य कैलासस्य च मध्ये ओषधीनां पर्वतः प्रकाशते।
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.30–32 (ऋषभ and the peak of Kailāsa; तयोः शिखरयोर्मध्ये … प्रदीप्तम्; the herbs blaze), 6.74.61

entries.en: The herbs know that he has come. They hide from him!
entries.sa: ओषधयः तम् आगतं जानन्ति। ताः न दृश्यन्ते!
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.62–64 (he searches; the herbs, knowing a seeker has come, go out of sight: ततो जग्मुरदर्शनम्)
cutscene herbs · question (Kathā) — the one choice (cannot fail)
cutscene herbs · option (player's reply, Kathā) — the only option; Yuddha 6.74.67 (he tears off the peak)

entries.en: Mountain, have you no pity for Rama? See my strength!
entries.sa: हे पर्वत, रामे तव दया न अस्ति वा? मम बलं पश्य!
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · person.hanuman (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.66 (to the mountain: यद्राघवे नासि कृतानुकम्पः … पश्याद्य मद्बाहुबलाभिभूतो)

entries.en: He takes the whole mountain and flies back, shining like the sun.
entries.sa: सः सर्वं पर्वतं गृहीत्वा आकाशेन प्रत्यागच्छति। सः सूर्यः इव प्रकाशते।
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.67–69 (he seizes the peak, leaps into the sky, shines like the sun: भास्करसंनिकाशः)

entries.en: Rama, Lakshmana and the vanaras breathe in the herbs. They rise, as if from sleep.
entries.sa: रामः लक्ष्मणः वानराः च ओषधीः जिघ्रन्ति। ते निद्रायाः इव उत्तिष्ठन्ति।
entries.ctx: cutscene herbs · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74.73–74 (तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम्; the army rises like sleepers at the end of night: निशान्तेष्विव संप्रबुद्धाः)
